_doc: Plugin routing for this repo (job 2026-10-26-always-on-hardening). required: plugins a house step routes to; the [health] machine line (scripts/agent-os/bootstrap-machine.mjs --check --hook) names each one this account has not enabled, with the enable line. Plugins are enabled per claude.ai account (synced) or per machine (installed, /plugin): the check can only detect and instruct. reject: plugins skill-recall never names (licence, routing hijack, duplicate of a house system, wrong business); rejectSkills: single skills. triggers: routing words added to a plugin skill or command so recall can name it. knownConnectFailures: MCP servers seen failing to connect, listed so a session reports them instead of retrying each one.

required.name: agentic-council
required.reason: manager step 2: /brainstorm (3 agents) or /council --quick --profile lean for a design with real tradeoffs
required.enable: claude.ai > Settings > Plugins (Anthropic Directory): enable agentic-council on this account

required.name: receipts-check
required.reason: manager step 9: prove-fix runs each new test on new and old code (PROVEN or THEATER), the mechanical check for positive-control-first
required.enable: claude.ai > Settings > Plugins (Anthropic Directory): enable receipts-check on this account

required.name: desktop-commander
required.reason: the sanctioned runner for installs outside a junctioned worktree (harness-worktree-setup section 3)
required.enable: claude.ai > Settings > Plugins (Anthropic Directory): enable desktop-commander on this account

required.name: avoid-ai-writing
required.reason: manager step 16: second pass on PR bodies and customer copy
required.enable: in Claude Code: /plugin marketplace add wshobson/agents, then /plugin install avoid-ai-writing@claude-code-workflows

required.name: pr-review-toolkit
required.reason: manager step 12: silent-failure-hunter and pr-test-analyzer beside adversarial-review

required.name: hookify
required.reason: turn a repeated mistake into a hook rule (draft only; guard-red-team canaries before it ships)
